item.title: Syria: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces fired across the border into southern Syria, killing a disabled Syrian man in the Daraa buffer zone and deploying rooftop snipers who opened fire in the south. Syrian security officers were killed in a raid on an ISIL cell near Damascus, and further clashes occurred in Rankous and the Damascus countryside. Protesters gathered across Syria to denounce repeated Israeli incursions, while a road linking Damascus and Suwayda was blocked amid demands for detainees' release and the Sweida-Damascus highway was completely closed by outlaw groups. Arms depot explosions in Syria left 37 dead. 2732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
The Rapid Support Forces have intensified drone strikes, hitting a market in Abyei and killing more than 150 civilians, and have deliberately bombed hospitals in el-Fasher, further limiting medical care. Drought and El Niño are worsening famine risk across war-torn Sudan, adding environmental pressure to the conflict. The United Nations is resuming peace efforts aimed at ending the drone war and easing the humanitarian crisis. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Cameroon: the situation
item.description:
Cameroon’s BIR rapid intervention force has broadened its deployment around Lake Chad while drones and joint border patrols continue in the Anglophone Northwest and Southwest, where separatists still attack government forces. Survivors of the 2016 Eseka rail disaster remain awaiting justice ten years after the crash, and a French court has authorized a third-party funder to enforce an ICC award against the state. The Supreme Court halted the appeal of a former minister sentenced for embezzlement, and a Cameroonian scholar has urged new peace talks with Anglophone separatists. The conflict caused 231 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Chad arrested four suspects after an attack in Miski, and CAR officials denied that their forces crossed the Chad border during a raid. Former hostages were released and greeted by President Touadéra in Bangui after returning from captivity. The conflict caused 246 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Myanmar's civil war: the situation
item.description:
Aung San Suu Kyi spoke with her son for the first time in over five years, and he reported hearing her voice and that she sounded fairly healthy. The conversation was accompanied by books and letters from King Charles III, which Myanmar authorities noted. Military commander Min Aung Hlaing met Japan envoy Sasakawa, showing diplomatic engagement despite ongoing fighting. At least two people were killed in a blast in the Rakhine state capital. The conflict still caused 2,332 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Southern Thailand: the situation
item.description:
Grenade blasts hit Thailand's southern insurgency zone, wounding security volunteers in Narathiwat and Yala, while a pipe bomb attack injured army officers in the same region. Cambodia continues to protest Thai military road construction in Oddar Meanchey and disputes over three border temples, with Thai officials rejecting the incursion claims. A Cambodian film about the 1979 refugee crisis has sparked controversy in Thailand, prompting officials to urge calm. The Thai government is introducing digital border passes to speed queues at the Mae Sai crossing and, together with Singapore and Malaysia, has joined the BLOOM cross-border digital money settlement initiative, and UCDP recorded 35 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russian forces have continued drone and missile strikes on Ukrainian civilian sites, including a deadly attack on an Oryol electronics plant and repeated hits on Moscow-area airports, while Ukrainian forces have retaliated with strikes on the same airports, a factory in Tolyatti and an airfield in Krasnodar Krai. In occupied Oleshky, a local cease-fire negotiated by Melania Trump has reduced fighting, and a separate truce was agreed for another town. Ukraine reports that Starlink speed restrictions have been lifted, restoring stable connectivity for its military. A secretive Ukrainian deep-strike unit is expanding its campaign, and the conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov visited Tehran and publicly backed Iran, hinting at possible Russian involvement as the United States and Israel draft plans for renewed strikes after the US midterm elections. In Yemen, Houthi attacks on Sanaa and Aden have killed civilians, and Saudi airstrikes in Houthi-controlled areas have also caused civilian deaths, including women and children. The United Nations warns that water supplies are dwindling in the besieged city of Taiz and in another Yemeni city under Houthi siege. item.title: Somalia: the situation
item.description:
Fitgharan forces now hold the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have taken Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia has withdrawn more than 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict, and a UAE drone strike in Puntland killed four family members, including a pregnant teenager. The US and UAE also carried out airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia, and 2,284 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Eastern DR Congo: the situation
item.description:
Ebola has reached an eighth province in eastern DRC, prompting alerts in Lubumbashi and border closures by Kenya and Uganda after 12 truck drivers were killed. The ADF continues attacks in Ituri while the FRN operates near Lubumbashi, and both UPDF and FARDC are conducting joint operations against ADF commanders in the region. A mercenary force suffered combat casualties in the Congo, and rebel-linked violence has led to civilian deaths. The conflict produced 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
